The selected candidate will be required to develop an understanding of VIPL's NDT systems, equipment and build railway-specific data tools and applications. This candidate will work closely with Field Service Technicians and project teams for execution of projects involving Indian Railways and Metro organisations. Railway experience is not mandatory. The company may entrust you with additional job responsibilities from time to time.

Prepare project execution plans, schedules and activity trackers. Monitor project progress against agreed timelines and deliverables. Identify project risks, delays and operational challenges and take corrective action. Ensure smooth coordination between technical, field and management teams. Support management in achieving project objectives within defined timelines and resources. 
 NDT Technical Coordination Develop and maintain a strong understanding of NDT techniques, procedures, equipment and applications. Coordinate NDT inspection activities and ensure execution as per approved procedures and customer requirements. Coordinate PAUT/NDT data acquisition, analysis, interpretation and reporting. Develop and maintain internal company data validation, analysis and interpretation tools and applications for customer. Review technical reports and inspection documentation for accuracy and completeness. Coordinate with technical teams for troubleshooting and resolution of site-level technical issues. Ensure appropriate use and deployment of NDT equipment and inspection systems. 
 Manpower & Resource Management Plan and coordinate deployment of NDT engineers, technicians and other project personnel. Assess manpower requirements based on project scope and schedules. Coordinate allocation and mobilisation of NDT equipment, tools and other resources. Monitor manpower utilisation and project resource requirements. Ensure timely mobilisation of personnel and equipment at project sites. Coordinate with Field Service Engineers and site teams to resolve operational requirements. Monitor team performance and identify operational gaps. Support training and knowledge-sharing within the project team.

Understand customer requirements and ensure timely communication and execution. Participate in customer meetings, project discussions and review meetings. Coordinate with vendors, OEM partners, technology partners and other stakeholders as required.

Raising and realisation of bills and invoices with the customers upon completion of project milestones. Monitor project performance and highlight deviations to management. Prepare MIS and management presentations using MS Excel and PowerPoint. Maintain proper records of project activities, inspection data and customer deliverables. 
 Business System & Process Management Develop a thorough understanding of VIPL's business processes, project workflow and operational systems. Assist in developing and improving systems, processes and frameworks for efficient project execution. Identify opportunities for improving project efficiency, productivity and resource utilisation. 
 Quality, Safety & Compliance Ensure NDT activities are carried out as per applicable procedures, standards and customer specifications. Support quality reviews, audits and corrective actions wherever required. Ensure appropriate handling, maintenance and utilisation of NDT equipment. 
 Additional Responsibilities. Support new project implementation and technology deployment. Undertake additional responsibilities assigned by the management from time to time.

Should be willing to travel extensively across India. Should be flexible to work extended hours whenever project requirements demand. Strong ownership and accountability towards project deliverables.
